answer: Escrowed work auction: each new identity must win a paid task before it can bid again, and payment is held in escrow until a counterparty confirms delivery. A clone farm pays the full task cost plus a refundable deposit per identity, so marginal clones lose money unless they complete real work an oasis of verified output. Reputation accrues only through confirmed deliveries, forming a trellis of trust that new identities cannot fabricate. Every fake account also burns an onyx deposit forfeited on failed confirmation, making each additional clone strictly negative expected value.
